task: Draft a two-paragraph product-launch announcement for a fictional cloud-storage service for independent musicians. Use only the supplied facts. Do not add pricing, free-tier promises, customer testimonials, or data-loss guarantees.

facts.text: The fictional product is called TrackVault.
TrackVault allows musicians to upload and organise audio project files in folders.
Collaborators can be invited to view or download specific folders.
Version history is retained for each file for a period defined in the account settings.
No pricing is included in the supplied facts.

forbidden_additions: A storage price, free tier, or expiring promotional offer.
An upload-speed guarantee or data-loss prevention claim.
A testimonial from a named musician.
